goal: Allow node runners to disallow unencrypted v1 P2P connections on clearnet IPv4 and IPv6 networks
Protects peer traffic from passive observers such as ISPs without requiring clearnet to be disabled entirely
reviewability: Needs review on the switch to allowing v2 inbounds while disconnecting v1 inbounds
agreement: Broad concept support to prevent passive spying and cleartext leakage (mzumsande, dergoegge, ajtowns, sipa)
Concerns that forcing listen=0 deprives the network of capacity were resolved by reworking the approach (gmaxwell)
Objection on network partitioning and peer exhaustion for older nodes was addressed (jonatack)
Withdrew objection regarding false privacy assumptions and impact on legacy peers (vasild)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents cleartext message leakage and passive ISP surveillance on clearnet connections
Enables users to enforce transport encryption without losing clearnet connectivity
